home.name: Pedro Almeida
home.detail: I develop digital experiences that combine performance, design, and technology. My goal is to create elegant, efficient, and well-structured solutions, delivering interfaces that provide an exceptional user experience.

about.title: About me
about.description: I have been working as a software developer since 2017. I hold a degree in Information Technology from Utramig and I am currently completing my Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering. I am passionate about technology and building efficient digital solutions, constantly seeking to improve my skills and explore new tools and technologies. I have experience in both Front-end and Back-end development, creating modern, scalable, and well-structured applications. I also use Artificial Intelligence as an ally in the development process, improving productivity and optimizing workflows to deliver higher-quality solutions faster. Beyond technology, I enjoy traveling, discovering new places, listening to and playing music.
